# Space-to-space sampling-effect envelope

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/s2s_envelope.py from docs/data/s2s_results.jsonl - do not edit; python scripts/s2s_envelope.py --check compares -->

How far DIRSIG's 110 space-to-space records of at least 0.3 px fall from their closed forms, by target size in pixels and motion (`docs/data/s2s_results.jsonl`, written by `scripts/s2s_measure.py`; [the characterization](Space_to_space_characterization.md) is the account, [the coverage map](s2s_coverage.md) the axes). The deficit of a measurement is 1 - measured / closed form, in percent; a negative deficit is an excess. Measurements: the flux closure of every record and, for a streak at least 1 px long, the fitted sweep length. A SatSim control (round 40) images the same geometry without DIRSIG's adaptive per-pixel sampling. Nothing here is tuned. `python scripts/s2s_envelope.py` writes this document and `--check` refuses a stale one.

## Bins and motions

- Size: the plate's side or the sphere's diameter over the pixel footprint at the stated range; bins 0.3 to 0.5 px, 0.5 to 1 px, 1 to 2 px, 2 to 6 px, 6 to 13 px, over 13 px (lower edge included).
- Motion: fixed (no motion), tracked (family II's orbit pair: the platform on its TLE with the line of sight on the plate, so no streak), platform (family II's `platform` group, the scene moving the other way), target (family I's moving plates, family II's `target` group), both (family II's `both` group).
- Label: labelled is a target named `::IMPORTANT::` (DIRSIG hypersamples it) or a resolved one; unlabelled the same 0.5 m plate or 0.25 m sphere without the name.
